description: Map an offer to email actions: when the trigger fires (purchase, refund, upsell_taken, renewal, abandoned, payment_failed, or dunning_recovered), the buyer is subscribed to the list and tagged. 'abandoned' fires for checkouts where the buyer STARTED a payment (clicked pay / opened a payment window) but never finished it (30+ minutes, excluded if they later bought) — buyers who only typed their email and left are not captured. 'payment_failed' fires once per dunning episode (a declined one-time payment, a failed renewal, or a PayPal suspension — not on every retry; note PayPal fires the same suspension event for manual pauses); 'dunning_recovered' fires when a failed subscription later collects, so you can stand the win-back journey down and tag the save. For buyers whose money never moved (a checkout decline), payment_failed applies the same EU/UK consent gate as 'abandoned' and only fires while the offer is live. This is what turns a checkout into a funnel with automated follow-up. Call list_followups first — creating a duplicate rule double-tags every buyer. Note: in the EU/UK, abandoned fan-out only fires for buyers who ticked the checkout consent box (it appears automatically on checkouts with an enabled abandoned rule).
name: set_followup
title: Set follow-up rule
